policies.exact: All output bits must match the independent expected value, including zero signs and movement of NaN payloads.
policies.fma: Exact rational references rounded once (fused) or twice (unfused). Select from compiled FMA metadata; only this declared contract difference is permitted.
policies.roundi: Exact references for the selected legacy implementation: FP64 uses fixed nearest for ARM backends and x86 AVX2, current direction for x86 SSE2/AVX-512; native x86 AVX-512 FP32 width 512 uses fixed nearest, other selected FP32 paths use current direction. Differences are explicitly reported as documented_rounding, never exact equality.
policies.ulp: Validate each result against the committed Decimal reference with the existing per-function ULP budget. Pairwise budget is the sum of both independent budgets.
policies.trig: Preserve tests/trig.cpp normalized-error floor and gates. Pairwise bound is the sum of independently applicable normalized bounds.
policies.reciprocal: Positive normal inputs away from underflow boundaries only; existing strict relative error less than 2^-11. Pairwise relative bound less than 2^-10. Boundary behavior stays in the existing full suite.

nan_policy: Capture raw payloads; exact movement/bitwise cases retain them. No general cross-backend NaN propagation or exception-flag equivalence is asserted.
